notes:
- When you play online, your palette is shown on https://soku.cleista.cc/ too, in its live rooms and replays (Aristo-cooperation W). Only your own side is sent when you're playing (not spectating). It's default on, you can turn it off with: [Site] Upload=0 in PaletteShare.ini.
- Fixed Online, pressing A twice quickly in the palette picker could start the match with the game's palette instead of the custom one you picked.
